**A career that’s the whole package!**
 At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.
   

  

**Conga** 
 lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Senior Technical Product Owner
   

  

**Locations:** 
 Bangalore, India
   

  

**Reports to** 
 : VP of Product Management
   

  

**A quick snapshot…**
 This role sits at the intersection of product and engineering. As a Senior Technical Product Owner, you will be embedded with Conga’s India\-based engineering teams for Conga Composer and Conga Sign, ensuring the backlog is always refined, requirements are technically sound, and the team has a clear path to delivery. You’ll work in close partnership with the Composer and Sign product managers, translating strategy into well\-scoped, executable work.
   

  

**Why it’s a big deal…**
 Composer and Sign are core products at Conga with a long track record of enterprise customer success and an exciting roadmap ahead. These are products used by thousands of businesses globally and central to Conga’s product strategy and revenue.
   

  

 The engineering teams building these products are talented and execution\-oriented. What they need is a TPO who keeps them unblocked, well\-informed, and focused on the right problems. If you are energized by getting requirements right, by being the connective tissue between strategy and delivery, and by earning the trust of both product and engineering, then this is an ideal role.
   

  

**Are you the person we’re looking for?**
**A proven product owner.** 
 You have 5\+ years of experience as a Product Owner or Technical PM in a B2B SaaS environment. You’ve written epics and user stories that engineering teams can execute without constant clarification and you take pride in getting requirements right the first time.
   

  

**Technically fluent.** 
 REST APIs are not a mystery to you. You understand how APIs are designed, documented, and consumed in enterprise software integrations, and you bring that knowledge into every refinement session and requirements conversation.
   

  

**An agile practitioner.** 
 You’ve worked directly with Agile/Scrum engineering teams, ideally in a distributed or offshore\-to\-HQ model.
   

  

**A clear and deliberate communicator.** 
 Whether you’re writing a user story, reviewing technical documentation, or explaining a complex integration requirement, your communication is clear, complete, and leaves no room for guesswork. You write for developers and speak to stakeholders with equal confidence.
   

  

**Education:** 
 A bachelor’s degree in Engineering or equivalent
   

  

**Here’s What Will Give You An Edge…**
 Day to day, here’s what you’ll be doing:
   

  

* Own epic and story refinement end\-to\-end: decompose product requirements into well\-scoped, technically grounded user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
* Serve as the primary day\-to\-day interface between product management and engineering scrum teams for Composer and Sign.
* Partner with engineering leads to identify dependencies, surface technical constraints early, and maintain a healthy, prioritized backlog.
* Collaborate closely with the Technical Publications team on documentation review, providing input and suggestions that help customers succeed with the product.
* Participate in sprint ceremonies (planning, retrospectives, demos) and hold the team accountable to story quality and delivery readiness.
* Translate complex technical concepts into clear product requirements.
* Escalate blockers, risks, and scope questions to product managers and engineering managers proactively and with enough context to act on.


**And if you bring any of these, you’ll hit the ground running:** 
 Familiarity with document automation, e\-signature, or process workflow concepts is a plus. Experience with Jira and Confluence gives you an immediate head start.
   

  

**Did we pique your interest?**
 If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. We'd love to hear from you!
   

  

**Preferred Resume Format**
 We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly.
   

  

**Don’t meet every requirement for the role?** 


 Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles.

 This role offers a rare opportunity to shape how HR shows up for every employee, every day. As the HR Service Delivery Product Owner and Knowledge Lead, you will lead askHR, UL Solutions’ global HR portal and primary entry point for HR support.
   

  

 This role exists to define, govern, and evolve the enterprise HR service delivery experience, acting as the single accountable owner for askHR as a global platform and knowledge ecosystem supporting more than 15,000 employees.
   

  

 You will directly influence how employees access HR services at scale, with measurable impact on HR efficiency, risk reduction, service quality, and employee confidence in HR support.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**HRSD Product Owner, platform and digital experience**
* Own the enterprise HR service delivery experience end to end, with accountability for design, usability, scalability, and performance across askHR, cases, workflows, journeys, and automation.
* Set and manage the HRSD roadmap, making enterprise level prioritisation decisions that balance employee experience, HR capacity, technical debt, and risk.
* Serve as the primary business owner for the HRSD platform in partnership with IT, accountable for outcomes rather than configuration alone.
* Own platform health and evolution, including release impact assessment, risk evaluation, adoption strategy, and value realisation.
* Own the askHR digital experience, with full accountability for how services, content, and transactions are surfaced globally.
* Run microsite and digital change governance, setting enterprise standards for intake, prioritisation, design, and publishing cadence.
* Manage digital campaigns and portal communications to intentionally shift employee behaviour toward self\-service and efficient resolution.


**Knowledge Lead, content and governance**
* Own HR knowledge strategy and quality, with enterprise accountability for accuracy, compliance, and consistency across regions and HR domains.
* Lead knowledge governance and review cycles, ensuring content is validated, current, and compliant, with clear ownership and escalation paths.
* Serve as the ServiceNow Knowledge Management subject matter expert, owning enterprise design decisions related to workflows, taxonomy, metadata, permissions, and lifecycle management.
* Act as the final decision authority on global knowledge standards and publishing exceptions when required.
* Use analytics to identify knowledge gaps, duplication, and improvement opportunities, and drive measurable change rather than reporting alone.
* Ensure knowledge supports case deflection, reduced repeat inquiries, and strong first contact resolution at enterprise scale.
* Maintain a consistent, employee friendly voice across all askHR content so the experience feels clear, human, and easy to navigate.
* Partner with regional People Operations teams and subject matter experts to keep content current, while governing how and where local variation is surfaced.


**Shared ownership and continuous improvement**
* Own reporting and insights across platform and knowledge, with accountability for improving enterprise HR service delivery outcomes over time.
* Establish clear, repeatable enterprise ways of working that reduce reliance on informal workarounds and individual knowledge.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, Information Systems, Communications, Digital Content, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Strong experience owning a digital product or enterprise platform, with accountability for roadmap, prioritisation, and outcomes.
* Experience working with HR Service Delivery platforms such as ServiceNow, including Employee Center, case management, workflows, and knowledge management.
* Strong writing, editing, and enterprise content governance skills, with the ability to maintain a clear employee voice.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with comfort operating as a single accountable owner without direct authority.
* Analytical mindset, comfortable using data to drive material change in service delivery.
* Practical, detail oriented approach with a strong focus on clarity, simplicity, and employee experience.


**About Us**
 A global leader in applied safety science, UL Solutions (NYSE: ULS) transforms safety, security and sustainability challenges into opportunities for customers in more than 110 countries. UL Solutions delivers testing, inspection and certification services, together with software products and advisory offerings, that support our customers’ product innovation and business growth. The UL Mark serves as a recognized symbol of trust in our customers’ products and reflects an unwavering commitment to advancing our safety mission. We help our customers innovate, launch new products and services, navigate global markets and complex supply chains, and grow sustainably and responsibly into the future. Our science is your advantage.

jobs.description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.  

  

DESCRIPTION:  

Join Thermo Fisher Scientific, the world leader in serving science. As a Business Analyst III, you'll contribute to bridging business needs with technology solutions to enable our mission of making the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Partner with stakeholders across our global organization to analyze processes, gather requirements, and implement solutions that drive operational excellence and business growth.  

  

You'll work with cross\-functional teams to identify opportunities, translate business needs into actionable requirements, and ensure successful delivery of high\-impact projects. Manage the full project lifecycle, from requirements gathering through implementation, while building strong relationships with business partners and technical teams.


We are looking for an experienced **Oracle JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Business Analyst** with strong expertise in **manufacturing, procurement, supply planning, demand planning, and supply chain management**. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in **end\-to\-end JD Edwards implementations**, strong functional configuration skills, and the ability to work closely with global business partners to deliver scalable supply chain solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Work as a **Business Analyst / Functional Consultant** for Oracle JD Edwards EnterpriseOne in the areas of **manufacturing, procurement, supply planning, and demand planning**.
* Lead and support **end\-to\-end implementation projects**, including requirement gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post\-go\-live support.
* Configure and support **new plants, sites, and multi\-facility business processes** in JD Edwards.
* Design and configure **manufacturing and procurement flows**, including shop floor, inventory, purchasing, planning, and related supply chain processes.
* Configure and support **MRP, supply planning, demand planning, and capacity requirements planning** across multiple facilities.
* Partner with global supply chain, manufacturing, procurement, planning, and IT teams to understand business requirements and translate them into JD Edwards solutions.
* Prepare detailed **functional specifications** for enhancements, integrations, reports, and custom developments.
* Support business process improvements across global supply chain operations.
* Collaborate with technical teams, business stakeholders, and implementation partners to ensure successful delivery.
* Provide strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder management throughout the project lifecycle.

  

REQUIREMENTS:

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Information Technology, Business, or a related field.
* Minimum 7 years of experience working with Oracle JD Edwards EnterpriseOne.
* Minimum 2 successful end\-to\-end JD Edwards implementation experiences.
* Strong functional experience in manufacturing, procurement, supply planning, and demand planning modules/processes.
* Hands\-on experience in **JD Edwards configuration** for manufacturing plants, procurement processes, planning, and multi\-facility setups.
* Strong understanding of MRP, capacity requirements planning, supply planning, and demand planning.
* Solid knowledge of end\-to\-end supply chain management concepts.
* Exposure to managing or supporting **global supply chain processes**.
* Experience working with business partners to gather requirements and deliver functional solutions.
* Strong experience in writing **functional specifications**, process documents, and configuration documents.
* Experience with data analysis, SQL, and visualization tools like Power BI
* Excellent project management skills with ability to manage initiatives
* Experience with Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow)
* Ability to build consensus across organizational boundaries
* Excellent presentation and facilitation skills for leading workshops and meetings
* Ability to manage shifting priorities in a results\-oriented environment
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts for non\-technical audiences
* Experience with process improvement methodologies (e.g., Six Sigma, Lean)
* + Willingness to travel up to 25% as needed

As a global leader in robotic\-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

Overview:
**170\+ Years Strong. Industry Leader. Global Impact.**  

At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. To do this, we provide enterprise risk management services and programs specifically designed for each client. Pinkerton employees are one of our most important assets and critical to the delivery of world\-class solutions. Bonded together, we share a commitment to integrity, vigilance, and excellence.

  

Pinkerton is an inclusive employer who seeks candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join our network of industry subject matter experts.

  

The Business Continuity Analyst to support a Fortune 100 corporate business continuity program focused on the APAC region. The Analyst will be responsible for executing business continuity plans developed by the Head of Business Continuity and Regional Business Continuity Managers, ensuring program consistency, operational readiness, and resilience across business units.


Responsibilities:
* Represent Pinkerton’s core values of integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
* Execute the business continuity strategy as developed by Corporate and Regional Business Continuity leadership.
* Partner with regional business teams to conduct business impact analyses and risk assessments.
* Identify critical services, define recovery objectives, and map critical dependencies.
* Document business continuity plan requirements within the corporate continuity tool to drive consistency and formal attestation.
* Collaborate with Business teams and Global Real Estate \& Facilities to coordinate recovery strategies identified through the planning process.
* Facilitate business continuity exercises and testing to identify plan gaps and validate work transfer and recovery processes.
* Analyze large datasets and produce meaningful reports to support decision\-making.
* Support the launch and maintenance of tools and points of contact (POC) for training initiatives.
* Serve as liaison with internal support teams to implement and maintain the program.
* Support workplace resilience initiatives by coordinating with stakeholders including Facilities, Business Continuity, Information Technology, Security, and Crisis Management to ensure seamless integration within the disaster response cycle..
* All other duties, as assigned.


Qualifications:
